description: Docs, workbooks and slides on the go. Acer Docs instantly syncs your documents on all of your devices. You can view and edit your Office documents updated in the last 30 days, using any of your devices, over a wireless or mobile network. Even when your PC is shut down, you can still access Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents from the last 30 days. Plus, Acer Docs is free! For more details, please visit the Acer Apps official website: http://www.acer.com/acercloud
